project.description:
Test infrastructure shared by every module: the JVM-lifetime Testcontainers Postgres and the context initializer that points a Spring test at it.
Only fixtures that depend on NOTHING in the platform live here. Anything that builds a tenant, a trace or a classifier belongs beside the module that owns those types - otherwise this module would sit above the features it exists to support, and nothing below them could use it.
Sources are in src/main so consumers depend on the jar with test scope; a test-jar would work too but makes the dependency harder to read and to resolve in an IDE.
